About Me

Passionate about building things that matter

I am pursuing my B.Sc. in Computer Science at Bishop Heber College, Trichy, maintaining a CGPA of 8.1. My academic journey is driven by a deep curiosity for how software shapes the world.

My technical toolkit spans the full stack — from crafting pixel-perfect UIs with React JS and HTML/CSS, to building robust backends with Node JS and MongoDB. I'm equally passionate about UI/UX Design, using Figma to create interfaces that feel intuitive and delightful.

Beyond code, I'm an active open-source contributor and freelancer, always eager to collaborate on projects that push boundaries. Great software lives at the intersection of technical excellence and human-centered design.
